description: Na₂Zn₂Se₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal P4_32_12 space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.90-3.14 Å. Zn is bonded to four Se atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ZnSe₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Zn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.57 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to three equivalent Na and three equivalent Zn atoms to form distorted SeNa₃Zn₃ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with six equivalent SeNa₂Zn₂ tetrahedra and edges with six equivalent SeNa₃Zn₃ pentagonal pyramids. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Zn atoms to form distorted corner-sharing SeNa₂Zn₂ tetrahedra.
